title: prunus henryi
intro: Prunus henryi, commonly known as Henry's cherry or Chinese cherry, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). It is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to China, used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The health benefits of Prunus henryi include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and modulating the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Prunus henryi include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and coumarins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
